videoInfo.title: The Happy Prince: Was He Always Happy? | Episodes 1–3 | Little Fox
videoInfo.purpose: 香港小學3年級英語學習，影片播放時老師展示對應詞彙與例句

wordSegments.englishSentence: Once upon a time, there was a young prince. He smiled and laughed all day long.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 從前，有一位年輕的王子。他整天微笑和大笑。

wordSegments.englishSentence: His parents, the king and queen, always said, "You're the perfect child."
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 他的父母，國王和王后，總是說：「你是完美的孩子。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: And they made sure the prince got everything he ever wanted.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 而且他們確保王子可以得到他想要的一切。

wordSegments.englishSentence: He said, "I want a pony." His parents gave him 10.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 他說：「我想要一匹小馬。」他的父母給了他十匹。

wordSegments.englishSentence: He said, "I want a new belt." They gave him one with two rubies and a sapphire.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 他說：「我想要一條新腰帶。」他們給了他一條鑲有兩顆紅寶石和一顆藍寶石的腰帶。

wordSegments.englishSentence: You might think that was why the prince was so happy, but you'd be wrong.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 你也許以為那就是王子很快樂的原因，但你錯了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The prince was happy because he never got into trouble. Not even when he behaved badly, which was most days.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子快樂是因為他從不會惹上麻煩。就算他表現很差的時候也不會，而大部分日子他都是這樣。

wordSegments.englishSentence: A nursemaid, Nana, watched over the prince.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 一位保姆娜娜照顧著王子。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Nana was loving and gentle and very good at her job.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜有愛心又溫柔，而且非常擅長她的工作。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Every day she'd gently remind him, "You are a very smart boy."
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 每一天她都會溫柔地提醒他：「你是一個非常聰明的男孩。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: Every night she'd tuck him into bed. A wonderful future awaits you, my precious prince.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 每個晚上她會幫他蓋好被子上床睡覺。美好的未來在等著你，我珍貴的王子。

wordSegments.englishSentence: But there was one thing Nana hadn't yet succeeded in doing, and it bothered her deeply.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 但是有一件事娜娜還沒有成功做到，這件事讓她非常煩惱。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I was sent to this castle for one reason. I must make sure he becomes a kind king.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 我被派到這座城堡只有一個理由。我必須確保他成為一位善良的國王。

wordSegments.englishSentence: So, she kept trying to teach him to be kind.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 所以，她不斷嘗試教他要善良。

wordSegments.englishSentence: "Your kingdom has many poor and sad families," she'd say. The prince would just shrug.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她會說：「你的王國有許多貧窮又悲傷的家庭。」王子只會聳聳肩。

wordSegments.englishSentence: "Oh, well, my family is rich and happy."
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 「噢，好吧，我的家庭富有又快樂。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: Nana finally went to the king for advice.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜最後去找國王尋求建議。

wordSegments.englishSentence: When the king heard how his son was acting, he grinned.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 當國王聽到他兒子的所作所為，他咧嘴笑了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Wonderful news. He will make a fine king one day.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 好消息。他有一天會成為一位優秀的國王。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Next, Nana went to the queen. Troubling behavior. But the queen covered her ears.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 接著，娜娜去找王后。（王子）的行為令人擔憂，但王后捂住了耳朵。

wordSegments.englishSentence: My son is a perfect angel.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 我的兒子是一個完美的天使。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Nana knew then that she was all on her own.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜那時知道她只能靠自己。

wordSegments.englishSentence: She was the only one who could teach the prince about kindness. But time was running out.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她是唯一可以教導王子什麼是善良的人。但是時間不多了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The prince is growing up. She thought soon he won't need me anymore.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子正在長大。她心想很快他就不再需要我了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Yet his heart is growing harder and colder by the day.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 然而他的心一天比一天變得更硬、更冷漠。

wordSegments.englishSentence: It was time to do something, something magical.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 是時候要做些事情了，一些有魔法的事情。

wordSegments.englishSentence: You see, Reader, Nana wasn't just a nursemaid. She was a fairy.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 你知道嗎，讀者，娜娜不只是保姆，她是一位仙女。

wordSegments.englishSentence: And it was the fairy queen who had sent her there.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 是仙女王后派她來到這裡。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The next king must be kind and fair. The fairy queen had said.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 仙女王后曾說：下一任國王必須善良又公正。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Nana had never used magic at the castle before.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜從來沒有在城堡裡用過魔法。

wordSegments.englishSentence: But now, she thought, I will do what I must do.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 但是現在，她心想，我要做我必須做的事。

wordSegments.englishSentence: A few days later, the king and queen left the castle.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 幾天之後，國王和王后離開了城堡。

wordSegments.englishSentence: They were going to visit a king in a far away land.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 他們要去拜訪一位在遙遠國度的國王。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Nana and the prince waved goodbye from the castle steps.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜和王子站在城堡台階上揮手道別。

wordSegments.englishSentence: "Nana, take care of my precious boy," the queen said.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王后說：「娜娜，好好照顧我珍貴的孩子。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: "Bring me presents," the prince shouted as the carriage rolled away.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 當馬車駛離的時候，王子大喊：「帶禮物回給我！」

wordSegments.englishSentence: Nana sighed. This was her chance to try a magic spell, but magic was serious.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜嘆了一口氣。這是她嘗試魔法咒語的機會，但魔法是很嚴肅的事情。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Fairies used it only when they had to.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 仙女只在迫不得已的時候才會使用魔法。

wordSegments.englishSentence: She decided to talk to the prince one last time.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她決定和王子做最後一次談話。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Prince, one day you'll rule this kingdom. You must have a kind and generous heart. Please show me that you can be kind.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子，有一天你將會統治這個王國。你必須擁有一顆善良又慷慨的心。請向我證明你可以變得善良。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Okay. The prince looked around.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 好的。王子向四周望了望。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I see some servant girls. I'll ask if they need anything. He ran to the servants.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 我看見一些女僕。我去問她們需不需要什麼。他跑向僕人們。

wordSegments.englishSentence: You're working so hard. Can I bring you a refreshment? The servant girls looked surprised.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 你們工作得好辛苦。我可以拿點飲品給你們嗎？女僕們看起來很驚訝。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Why, um, certainly, your highness, one said. Great. I'll get some fruit.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 其中一位說：「呃，當然可以，殿下。」太好了，我去拿一些水果。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The prince dashed into the castle. He returned with a bowl of fruit.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子衝進城堡。他拿著一碗水果回來。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Nana beamed. He's learning.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜面露喜色。他正在學習。

wordSegments.englishSentence: She thought maybe magic isn't needed after all.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她心想也許終究不需要魔法。

wordSegments.englishSentence: But then the prince laughed and threw the fruit at them. Stop that.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 但是接著王子大笑，並把水果丟向她們。不要那樣做。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Nana pulled the prince away.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜把王子拉開。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I've tried to teach you to be kind, but your heart is as cold as stone.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 我已經嘗試教你要善良，但你的心像石頭一樣冰冷。

wordSegments.englishSentence: So, I must do what I must do.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 所以，我必須做我該做的事。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The prince laughed. Like what? Like this.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子笑了。像什麼？像這樣。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The prince turned into a statue of stone covered in gold.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王子變成一座覆蓋著黃金的石頭雕像。

wordSegments.englishSentence: You will stand frozen above the village, watching your people.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 你將會僵立在村莊上方，看著你的子民。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Seeing their struggles will surely soften your heart.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 看見他們的困苦一定會軟化你的心。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Break this spell now, the statue cried.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 雕像大喊：「現在解除這個咒語！」

wordSegments.englishSentence: Only you can do that, Nana said. Tell me when you know how to be kind.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜說：「只有你自己可以做到。當你懂得如何善良的時候就告訴我。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: Days passed.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 日子一天天過去。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Nana waited, nervously, watching the statue.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜緊張地等待，守看著雕像。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Surely the prince sees the people's troubles now, she thought. And surely he wants to help them.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她心想，王子現在一定看見人們的苦難，他一定想要幫助他們。

wordSegments.englishSentence: But the statue stayed silent.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 但是雕像保持沉默。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Then one day, news came. The king and queen were returning home.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 然後有一天，消息傳來。國王和王后正要返家。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Nana ran to the statue.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜跑向雕像。

wordSegments.englishSentence: "I can't let them see my magic spell." She thought.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她心想：「我不能讓他們看見我的魔法咒語。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: She tried to break the spell herself, but nothing worked. The magic was too strong.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 她嘗試自己解除咒語，但什麼都沒有用。魔法太強大了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Nana buried her face in her hands. The king will throw me into the dungeon.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜把臉埋在雙手之中。國王會把我丟進地牢。

wordSegments.englishSentence: I must leave at once.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 我必須立刻離開。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Nana disappeared, leaving the statue all alone.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 娜娜消失了，留下雕像孤零零一個。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The king and queen stared at the stone statue in horror.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 國王和王后驚恐地盯著石雕像。

wordSegments.englishSentence: "That's not our son," the king said.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 國王說：「那不是我們的兒子。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: "My baby has been kidnapped." the queen cried. And the villains left a statue in his place.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 王后哭著說：「我的孩子被綁架了。」壞人留下一座雕像來替代他。

wordSegments.englishSentence: This is Nana's fault. The king growled. Guards, find her, then throw her in the dungeon.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 國王低吼：「這都是娜娜的錯。侍衛，找到她，然後把她丟進地牢。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: But the guards could not find Nana, and the prince's parents couldn't bear to look at the statue.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 但是侍衛找不到娜娜，王子的父母也無法忍受看著那座雕像。

wordSegments.englishSentence: so they sent it to a town far from the castle.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 所以他們把雕像送到遠離城堡的小鎮。

wordSegments.englishSentence: The town's people were happy to have such a beautiful statue.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 小鎮的人很高興擁有這麼一座美麗的雕像。

wordSegments.englishSentence: It was made of stone, but covered in gleaming gold.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 它是石頭製成，但是外層覆蓋閃亮的黃金。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Three sparkling jewels sat in its belt.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 腰帶上鑲著三顆閃耀的寶石。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Often the people gathered at the statue's base talking about it. We're so lucky to have this statue.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 人們常常聚集在雕像底座談論它。我們很幸運擁有這座雕像。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Look at his smile. Let's call him the happy prince.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 看他的笑容。我們叫他快樂王子吧。

wordSegments.englishSentence: One day, a flock of swallows flew over the town.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 有一天，一群燕子飛過小鎮上空。

wordSegments.englishSentence: This looks like a nice place, their leader said. We'll spend the rest of the summer here.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 牠們的領隊說：「這看起來是個不錯的地方。我們會在這裡度過夏天剩餘的時光。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: Then we'll fly to Egypt for the winter.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 然後我們會飛去埃及過冬天。

wordSegments.englishSentence: And that's exactly what the swallows did.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 燕子們就照著這樣做了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Most of them stayed in town, but one swallow liked to spend his time at the lake.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 大部份燕子留在小鎮，但有一隻燕子喜歡在湖邊消磨時間。

wordSegments.englishSentence: One day, the leader flew to talk to him.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 有一天，領隊飛過來跟牠說話。

wordSegments.englishSentence: "Please join the rest of the flock," leader said. "The summer is almost over.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 領隊說：「請回到鳥群之中，夏天差不多快要結束了。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: We will leave for Egypt soon. I'm not going to Egypt, Swallow said.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 「我們很快就要動身前往埃及。」燕子說：「我不去埃及。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: Because I am in love.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 因為我墜入愛河了。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Not again, leader thought. But he smiled politely.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 領隊心想：「不會又來了吧。」但牠禮貌地微笑。

wordSegments.englishSentence: With who? He asked.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 牠問：「愛上誰？」

wordSegments.englishSentence: Come, I'll introduce you to my love, Swallow said. He led leader out over the water.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 燕子說：「過來，我介紹我的愛人給你認識。」牠帶領領隊飛到水面上方。

wordSegments.englishSentence: As they flew, Swallow said, "She is the most beautiful thing in the world." Now, every bird knew that Swallow loved beautiful things.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 牠們飛行的時候，燕子說：「她是全世界最美麗的事物。」每一隻鳥都知道燕子喜愛美麗的事物。

wordSegments.englishSentence: He fell in love every season.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 牠每個季節都會墜入愛河。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Leader thought, "Is he talking about the lake this time? The sun set. Another bird maybe.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 領隊心想：「這次牠愛上的會是湖泊嗎？太陽下山了，也許是另一隻鳥。」

wordSegments.englishSentence: That's when swallow landed lightly on a tall reed. Leader gasped.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 就在那時候，燕子輕輕降落在高高的蘆葦上。領隊倒抽一口氣。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Your love is a reed. Yes. Swallow smiled. Isn't she beautiful?
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 「你的愛人是一根蘆葦？」「對。」燕子微笑，「她難道不美嗎？」

wordSegments.englishSentence: Leader didn't want to be rude. And reader. Neither do I.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 領隊不想無禮，而我（敘述者）也一樣。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Don't get me wrong, she was a lovely reed. She swayed in the breeze.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 別誤會，那是一株可愛的蘆葦。她在微風中搖曳。

wordSegments.englishSentence: She held Swallow gently when he landed on her, but she was still a reed.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 當燕子降落在她身上，她溫柔地承接住燕子，但她始終只是一株蘆葦。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Later blinked a few times. I hope you change your mind. Winter is coming. It will get very cold here.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 後來領隊眨了好幾下眼睛。我希望你可以改變主意。冬天快要來了，這裡將會變得非常寒冷。

wordSegments.englishSentence: Swallow didn't reply. He just smiled and stared at his beloved Reed.
wordSegments.chineseTranslation: 燕子沒有回應。他只是微笑，凝視著他心愛的蘆葦。
